note: #1645 (CPO, #1622): recorded-style ad_review_feedback items in Meta's shape (policy key from Meta's Advertising Standards names, message in Meta's voice) for the IELTS and interiors pilots. Not live recordings: no pilot ad has been rejected yet; replace with real ones when they come.

misleading.message: Ads must not make claims that are deceptive or unrealistic, such as a guaranteed band score or visa approval.

personal.message: Ads must not assert or imply personal attributes. Failed IELTS? implies the viewer failed an exam.

personal_words_only.message: Your ad says 'Visa refused? Low band?' which refers to the person seeing it.

job_policy.message: Ads must not promote job offers or immigration schemes that may be deceptive.

job_words_only.message: This ad offers a work permit and jobs in Canada with PR.

housing.message: Ads about housing, such as 2BHK flats and prices per sq ft, need the Housing special ad category.

misleading.message: Ads must not claim the lowest price or a guaranteed handover date.
